name: Passeport Talent — Salarié qualifié

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a signed employment contract (CDI, or CDD of at least 3 months to 1 year depending on the specific sub-case) with an employer established in France.
This requires a qualification at least equivalent to a Bac+3 (3 years of higher education, e.g. a licence/bachelor), or 5 years of recognised equivalent professional experience.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain formal recognition of your qualification via ENIC-NARIC France if issued outside the EU.

value.note: fixed by ministerial arrêté, not automatically SMIC-indexed

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a gross annual salary of at least €39,582 (2026 reference figure, fixed by the 21 August 2025 arrêté).
requirements.fix_path: Negotiate a higher salary meeting the reference threshold.

evidence_required.document: Signed employment contract meeting the salary threshold
Degree certificate or ENIC-NARIC recognition, or documented 5+ years' equivalent experience

outcome.duration_length: up to 4 years, matching contract duration if shorter, renewable

sources.title: Légifrance — CESEDA Art. L421-9 à L421-25 (carte de séjour pluriannuelle 'talent')

notes: MAJOR METHODOLOGY-LEVEL STALE-DATA FINDING, the first of its kind in this dataset: the salary threshold used to be a live 1.5x SMIC calculation (updating automatically every time SMIC revalued), but is now FIXED by ministerial arrêté (currently €39,582, set 21 August 2025) and stays fixed regardless of subsequent SMIC changes until a new arrêté is published. Multiple tier-3 sites still describe the threshold as '1.5 × SMIC ≈ €2,844/month' — this isn't just a stale NUMBER, it's a stale METHODOLOGY, since even recalculating '1.5 × current SMIC' would give a different (wrong) answer now that the two are decoupled. This is a materially different and arguably more interesting counterfeit-figure case than the usual 'annual reindex was missed' pattern seen elsewhere in this dataset (UK, Germany, Netherlands, Portugal, Spain), since here the underlying CALCULATION itself changed, not just an input value. No opposabilité de l'emploi (labour-market test) — a genuine advantage over the standard VLS-TS salarié route. Distinct from a simple work permit: covers the employee's family in the same procedure, with immediate unrestricted work rights for the spouse — a real advantage over most standard work routes worldwide in this dataset. Reduced 2-year citizenship path exists for certain qualified profiles per some secondary sources, but this specific reduction was not independently confirmed at tier-1 level during this research pass — citizenship_after_months here uses the standard 5-year figure rather than asserting the reduction as settled fact.
